## Mistake Patterns

### Claiming done without verifying
**What it looks like:** reports tests passed or a change is live, citing output from an earlier run or none at all.
**Reminder line:** never say a check passed unless you ran it this turn and read the output.
**Evidence:** "you didn't actually run the tests - run them and show me" (2026-08-20); "did you actually run these? show me the real output" (2026-08-21).
